label: main season
summary: The national database records a past landmine accident inside the area. Although the unchecked record is indirect evidence and its location has not been verified on the ground, the national criteria make it a clearance target after the first NTS visit and do not provide technical survey. Recommend clearance for sign-off; the NTS evidence does not establish safe use or absence in the interior.
flags: Visit 1 reached only the edge because rain closed the trail; the interior was not observed.

checks.detail: Every item of the evidence log is in the register.
The national criteria provide no technical survey, so clearance takes its place; evidence to target: E1.

E1.quote: The national mine action database records one or more past landmine accidents inside this area.
E1.note: The database record has no date or detail and its location has not been ground-checked, so it is an unchecked historical record suggesting possible EO presence.

E2.quote: A bus driver said he only passes along the road at the edge of the area and does not know the land inside it.
E2.note: The informant expressly does not know the land inside and provides no information about EO presence or safe use there.

E3.quote: The survey team could reach only the edge of the area, because rain had closed the trail into it, and could not see the land inside.
E3.note: The team's observation establishes that the interior was not observed; it supports neither presence nor absence of EO there.
